Responsibilities

The monetization technology team works on building and running large-scale, globally distributed, fault-tolerant ads systems. SREs keep the systems up and running with the highest level of availability, ensuring our users have the best experience possible.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.

-  Manage and plan infrastructure capacity for the advertising systems, ensuring resources scale efficiently with business growth while continuously improving infrastructure utilization through performance optimization.
-  Develop reliability platforms and engineering tools for the advertising systems, including monitoring, alerting, SLO management, risk governance, and resource management.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:



-  Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
-  Expertise in Unix/Linux operating systems, IP networking.
-  Experience programming in at least one of the following programming languages: Python, Go, C, C++, or Java.
-  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a strong sense of ownership, and excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications:



-  Experience in SRE internship for large-scale advertising, recommendation, search systems, or large-scale cloud platforms.

jd:
We are seeking a motivated and curious 2027 Summer Intern, Cloud Engineer (AWS / Azure) to join our team and support cloud DevOps, governance, and security compliance work across AWS and Azure environments. You'll work on a team that treats AI and automation as core engineering practice, so this is a hands-on opportunity to build real-world experience in cloud governance, security, and AI-assisted automation while contributing to the evolution of our Fathom Platform within the SCS environment.

 This is an entry-level, 10-week, full-time internship expected to begin in June and end in August. Work will be hybrid from Reston, VA. Pay is expected to be $27 per hour for undergraduate interns and $32 per hour for graduate interns. At this time, we are unable to provide housing nor relocation assistance for this position. 

 What You'll Do 
 You'll rotate across the team's core areas of work, with specific projects assigned based on team priorities at the time:
 
• Cloud DevOps & Automation:  Support infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD automation used to build and maintain cloud environments. Help write, test, and document automation that provisions and manages resources across AWS and Azure. 
• Cloud Governance:  Assist in the administration and governance of AWS and Azure organizations, including account/subscription structure, identity and access management (IAM), and policy-based guardrails that keep environments consistent and compliant. 
• Security & ATO Compliance:  Contribute to security tooling and compliance efforts that support Authorization to Operate (ATO), including work aligned to security control baselines (such as NIST 800-53), vulnerability and posture management, and evidence/documentation for audits. 
• AI-Enabled Engineering:  Work the way the team works - using AI-assisted development as a core practice. This includes: 
• AI IDE development  - using AI-enabled IDEs and coding assistants to generate, refactor, and document scripts, infrastructure-as-code, and automation, then validating and correcting the output before use. 
• Spec-driven development  - turning requirements into clear specifications that guide implementation, and using those specs to plan and structure work. 
• Productivity-as-code  - capturing repeatable work as reusable prompts, workflows, agents, and automation so that effort compounds into leverage for the whole team rather than one-off tasks. 
• Collaborate with engineers on cloud-native products and services, and participate in team meetings, code reviews, and documentation efforts. 
 Skills & Tools You May Work With 
 Exact tools vary by project, but you'll gain exposure to:
 
• Cloud platforms:  AWS and Azure (multi-account / multi-subscription administration, IAM, networking, and security services) 
• DevOps & IaC:  infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Pulumi, Terraform, or CloudFormation; GitHub / GitHub Actions) 
• Governance:  organization-level policy and guardrail management, identity and access management 
• Security & compliance:  cloud security posture and vulnerability management tooling, and security control frameworks supporting ATO (e.g., NIST 800-53) 
• AI-enabled engineering:  AI-enabled IDEs and coding assistants, spec-driven development, and productivity-as-code practices, applied with appropriate review and governance 
 Basic Qualifications 
 
• Must be able to pass any required background check(s), which may include drug screening. 
• U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Work Authorization is required due to federal contract requirements. 
• By start date, a minimum of 60 completed college-level credit hours preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
• A completed bachelor's degree. 
• By start date, acceptance/enrollment verification, or at least 9 credit hours of completed graduate-level courses preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure). 
• AWS or Azure Associate Certification (or actively pursuing). 
• Basic understanding of networking, IAM, and cloud security principles. 
• Exposure to infrastructure-as-code or CI/CD concepts is a plus. 
• Interest in cloud compliance, governance, or security (ATO/RMF, NIST) is a plus. 
• Experience using AI tools (such as AI coding assistants or chat assistants) to support technical or analytical work is a plus. 
• Enthusiasm for learning and applying new technologies. 
• Strong communication and collaboration skills. 
 Why Join Us? 
 
• Work on impactful cloud DevOps, governance, and security projects in a supportive, learning-focused environment. 
• Gain exposure to enterprise cloud architecture, DevSecOps, AI-enabled engineering, and compliance/ATO practices. 
• Grow your ability to apply AI and automation responsibly at professional scale, mentored by experienced cloud engineers.

 The Center for Applied Systems and Software (CASS) exists as a student internship program. Hourly students are hired and trained by full-time developers or student managers, to perform computer development projects. Student jobs/internships average 1 to 3 years in length, and most graduates are hired by technology companies.
